title: Rolling aerobic, tired legs
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 1h40 at 140-150bpm on rolling terrain, ~300m D+, cadence 172+, run the descents relaxed.
GYM: Copenhagen 2x30s/side.
FUEL: 1 flask Tailwind from min 30.
GARMIN: ~120-140.
STOP RULE: quads sore after Saturday, 1h20 flat at the same HR.
WHY: back-to-back on tired legs is the VWT second-half stimulus; HR cap stops it becoming a second long run.
